markup.message: <form> is inside another <form>, which HTML does not allow: the browser drops the inner <form>, and its fields send with the outer one.
<button> is inside <a>, and nothing interactive may be inside a link or a button: the browser cannot tell which one is clicked, and a screen reader announces only the outer. Put it next to the <a>.
